Nvidia Faces Scrutiny Over Ex-Executive's Alleged China Chip Diversions

Nvidia is facing renewed scrutiny following allegations that its former executive Jay Puri and his wife, Cenly Chen, diverted chips to China. Short-seller Muddy Waters has raised questions about Supermicro and chip shipments, linking them to Puri, who was formerly Nvidia's No. 3 executive. The situation involves an alleged $2.5 billion China chip scandal.
